deadlines.notes: The requirements pages for Computer Science, Economics and Engineering give international application dates for the Fall 2027 intake as 15 Aug 2026 to 1 Apr 2027. The general dates page (https://www.ucalgary.ca/future-students/undergraduate/admissions/dates) separately lists 1 March as the Fall application deadline (application fee and program choices) and 15 March for unofficial transcripts and supporting documents, so aim for 1 March. Most offers are made after first-term Grade 12 transcripts arrive.

english_policy.waiver_notes: All applicants must meet the English language requirement. Without a test: 3 years of study in an ELP-exempt country (the list includes the United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, India, Ireland, Nigeria, Singapore, South Africa) or at an accredited Canadian, American, British or CIS school; 2 years at a recognized post-secondary institution; Alberta English 30-1 at 80%; IB English A 5+ or English B HL 6+; AP English Language or Literature 4+; GCSE/AS/A-level English (non-ESL) grade B (6 on the 9-point scale) or better; or a UCalgary English course at B- or better. ESL-only study requires a test.

english.notes: IELTS Academic (or IELTS Indicator); no band minimum for most undergraduate programs. Nursing and Education need higher scores.
Old 0-120 scale, tests taken before 21 Jan 2026; no section minimum for most programs. School code 0813.
New 1-6 scale, tests on or after 21 Jan 2026; no section minimum for most programs.
Most undergraduate programs; Nursing needs 130 and Education 150 with integrated subscores.
PTE Academic; Nursing needs 65 and Education 80 with skill minimums.
Cambridge C1 Advanced or C2 Proficiency (180 for most programs). CAEL 70 is also accepted.

tier_notes.general: QS World University Rankings 2027: world rank 249, 11th of the Canadian universities in the table (A = ranks 6-15 on the national scale; a national scale, so not comparable with US tiers).
